title: QB2_A#q33 cited Grain Code A 7 for the Document of Authorisation. A 3 is the document, A 6 the booklet, A 7 the stability criteria - and the card was already citing A 7.1.2 correctly for the residual-area criterion two paragraphs earlier, so it contradicted itself.
candidate_claim: Not a candidate report. Tranche 4 finding P1-01, with coupled P2-01.
candidate_verdict: UPHELD from held primary bytes. Resolution MSC.23(59), the Grain Code as adopted, is held: section 3 is DOCUMENT OF AUTHORIZATION, section 6 is INFORMATION REGARDING SHIP'S STABILITY AND GRAIN LOADING ("Information in printed booklet form"), section 7 is STABILITY REQUIREMENTS. The registry row for SRC-GRAINCODE-PARTA-TEXT independently records reliance on A 3.1, A 3.2, A 3.5 and A 6.1 for exactly these propositions.
authority:
MSC.23(59) A 3, A 6, A 7 read in full from the held resolution. A 7.1.1 verbatim: "the angle of heel due to the shift of grain shall not be greater than 12 degrees or in the case of ships constructed on or after 1 January 1994 the angle at which the deck edge is immersed, whichever is the lesser".

SOURCES RELIED ON: SRC-GRAINCODE-MSC23-59, SRC-GRAINCODE-MSC552-2026, SRC-GRAINCODE-PARTA-TEXT.
